name: ROMs Collection Manager
description:
Your Retro Collection. Perfectly curated & ready to play.
No more file chaos, duplicates, and cryptic filenames like smw_v1_0_[b1].smc. ROM Collection Manager analyzes your library using No-Intro and 1G1R standards, organizes multi-disc sets into subfolders, and generates plug-and-play M3U playlists.
author: Hansjuerg Wuethrich
